tips.text: cs can draw a bar per prompt on its band, to scroll back to any prompt: run /config and turn on cs: Band: prompt bars
every cs setting is in one pane: run /cs, type to search, and press Enter on a row to change it

cs settings need no export in your shell: cs -config set <KEY> <value> keeps one for this machine, cs <name> -config set for one session, and cs -config list shows every setting and where its value comes from
to see only your prompts and Claude's answers in this session, run /filter-chat; run it again to show the work between them
run /wrap when a session winds down: before it saves memory and the summary, it lists where the session struggled and files one task per fix for you to pick from, applying none
a launcher that cannot press a key can open a session with cs <name> --resume: it resumes the recorded conversation without asking, or starts fresh when the session has none
reopening a session with cs <name> shows how full its last conversation got; from the status line's red mark, 60% by default, Enter starts a fresh conversation and y still resumes
from 60% context Claude suggests a rotation and writes a handoff with /rotate after its answer; run /clear and a fresh conversation picks the work up from it
ask Claude to show you how a flow works and the reply draws it as a flowchart; /config's cs: Draw mermaid diagrams turns the drawing off
